sourceEvidence.title: Supplier Quality Manager
sourceEvidence.quote:
## Summary
• Collaborate closely with Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing Operations, and Quality teams on technical issues, risk management, audits, and nonconformance resolution.
• Maintain independence, uphold traceability, and ensure robust control of nonconforming materials.
We’d Love to Hear from Candidates With
• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, physical sciences, or related technical field—or equivalent technical experience.
• 5+ years of quality‑related experience, including at least 3 years in a supervisory capacity.
• Strong ability to interpret drawings, specifications, GD&T, and supplier documentation.
• Hands‑on knowledge of inspection methods and verification tools.
• Ability to obtain and maintain a DOE/NRC Q‑level security clearance.
A Successful Candidate Also Brings
• Experience with ASME NQA‑1, ISO 9001, AS9100, or other regulated quality programs.
• Background in supplier auditing, capability assessments, and corrective action management.
• Familiarity with APQP, PFMEA, PPAP/FAI, or process capability analysis.
• Professional certifications such as ASQ CQE/CQT/CQA, NQA‑1 Lead Auditor, or relevant NDT credentials.
Pay:
Estimated Starting Base Salary Range: $141,650-200,000 This position is incentive eligible.
Centrus considers several factors when extending job offers, including but not limited to candidates’ key skills, relevant work experience, and education/training/certifications. While the posted range reflects the anticipated hiring range for this position, compensation above the range may be considered for candidates with exceptional qualifications and directly relevant experience.
In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.
This position will require a pre-employment background check and a pre-employment drug test.
Centrus Energy and all subsidiaries shall abide by the applicable legal requirements.
We prohibit discrimination against qualified individuals based on their status as protected veterans or individuals with disabilities and prohibit discrimination against all individuals based on their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin.
This position requires the successful candidate to obtain and maintain a Q security clearance.
Candidates for positions requiring a security clearance are required to be tested for the absence of any illegal drug as defined in 10 CFR 707.4 prior to an offer of employment being made.
